component.name: PhotoTux
component.summary: GPU-first image editor for Linux and Wayland

description.p: PhotoTux is a dense desktop image editor built with Rust, Qt Quick, Vulkan and wgpu. Its interactive canvas keeps document pixels on the GPU, so large documents stay responsive: nothing crosses the language boundary while you paint, pan or zoom.
The workspace is shaped after Adobe Photoshop, so placements carry over, and drawn in the idiom of KDE Plasma 6.

ul.li: Raster, group, text, shape, fill, adjustment and smart-object layers
Layer masks, 28 blend modes and eight layer styles
Non-destructive adjustment layers and a per-layer filter plan
Selections by rectangle, ellipse, freehand, polygon and colour
Brush, clone stamp, eraser, gradient, dodge, burn and blur tools
Native layered .ptx documents, layered PSD import and export
PNG, JPEG, WebP, TIFF, BMP and GIF, with ICC colour management

description.p: Pre-release development build. Not yet tagged for distribution.
